item.title: Registration underway for the 43rd Alabama State Games
item.description: This year's event will take place once again in Birmingham with opening ceremonies kicking it off on Friday, June 12 at Legacy Arena.

item.title: Mainly dry, above-normal warm weather for the first week of March
item.description: Monday afternoon remains partly to mostly sunny with high temperatures in the upper 70s. Monday night looks partly cloudy and mild with lows in the mid 50s. Some fog may form early Tuesday morning.

item.title: Montgomery Humane Society Marketing Director retires after 20 years of service to the community
item.description: After helping the unhoused animals of the River Region find homes for the last 2 decades, Lea Turbert of the Montgomery Humane Society has retired.

item.title: Get ready to take flight with ADT’s production of ‘Peter Pan’
item.description: The week kicks off with a special evening with one of the most influential artists.

item.title: Man shot at Auburn apartment complex
item.description: It happened around 2:18 p.m. Monday in the 500 block of Shelton Mill Road.

item.title: Opelika man arrested for abuse
item.description: Sheriff Jones says investigators traveled to Barrett's employment and arrested him.

item.title: MPS to hold upcoming Heritage and Resource Fair
item.description: The fair is designed to celebrate the rich cultures, traditions and histories represented within the school community.

item.title: Jury selection underway in the capital murder trial of Ibraheem Yazeed
item.description: Jury selection will continue Tuesday at 9 a.m.

item.title: The 76th Annual Alabama YMCA Youth Legislature Conference in Montgomery
item.description: The Alabama State House was full of people this past weekend, but not with those you'd usually expect to see.
